messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xxs on inference-prod (route: /v1/generate). Error rate 7.8% over last 5m, queue depth on gpu-pool-a = 420. Paging eng-oncall.
anna: I'm on it, grabbing logs + tailing the router. ETA 2m.
anna: quick note: looks correlated to a subset of API keys with high concurrent streaming sessions. Top offenders: key-378, key-994, key-217.
anna: Migration-ish traffic pattern — long lived streams with many small tokens causing KV pressure.
sasha: adding context: recent rollout of streaming-optimizations v2 last night? Could be regressing for long contexts.
miguel: I can flip the runtime knob to reduce max concurrent streams per shard. Want me to apply conservative limit (10 -> 4)?
anna: Yes, do that. Also let's apply emergency soft-rate limit per API key at 100 rps for now to stop overwhelming the pool. Will notify CS for affected customers.
miguel: running command now:
```
./ctl-runtime update-pool --pool gpu-pool-a --max-streams-per-shard 4
./ctl-quota bump --key key-378 --per-minute 6000 --note "emergency soft limit"
```
miguel: applied limit and soft bumps to the worst offenders; propagating in 30s.
anna: Observability: I'm watching tail of 5xxs; they dropped to 3.1% after the flip. Queue depth down to 180. Good sign.
devon: I'm taking the handoff in 30m. Can you capture the mitigation steps and any temporary config values? I'll keep the pager if it flares.
anna: Copy. Summary to hand off:
- reduced max streams/shard: 10 -> 4
- per-key emergency soft-rate limits applied to key-378, key-994, key-217
- temporarily disabled aggressive streaming-batching for gpu-pool-a (runtime flag streaming_batch=false)
- CS notified to reach out to top customers for connection trims
anna: Re: SDK guidance for customers: recommend adding idempotency tokens for non-streamed requests and reducing client-side retries for streaming endpoints. Also suggest exponential backoff with jitter when 429/500 observed.
anna: Example SDK guidance snippet to publish to status/dashboard and docs:
```
// recommended retry/backoff policy for SDKs (javascript):
const retryPolicy = {
  retries: 3, // reduce from default 5 for streaming-heavy paths
  backoff: (attempt) => Math.min(2000 * 2 ** attempt, 20000) + Math.floor(Math.random()*200),
  retryOn: [429, 500, 502, 503],
  idempotencyKeyHeader: 'x-idempotency-key' // encourage clients to surface this
};
```
anna: And an immediate client-side mitigation note to send to customers:
- Lower concurrency of streaming connections
- Add jittered exponential backoff (see code snippet)
- Add idempotency keys for non-streamed calls to allow safe retries
- Temporarily pause aggressive background polling if you're using the SDK for embedding refresh
sasha: Can we also recommend toggling streaming to polling for heavy customers? We have a quick flag they can flip in the SDK: `client.options.streaming = false`.
cs-bot: Notified CS with affected customer list: key-378 (Acme Corp), key-994 (BrightApps), key-217 (PlatformX). CS will ping customers and post on the status page.
anna: Customer impact: degraded latency for streaming calls (timeouts), some 500s returned for long sessions. Non-streaming generation looks mostly normal. Root cause hypothesis: KV cache contention + aggressive streaming batching introduced regressions for very long-lived connections.
devon: If the 5xxs creep back above 5% after the current config stabilizes, plan B: temporarily disable streaming for all non-enterprise tiers and auto-route to non-stream endpoints. I can schedule that toggle if needed.
anna: Agree. Also plan to add a short-lived rollout to revert streaming-optimizations v2 on gpu-pool-a to confirm regression. I'll raise a deploy rollback PR and tag eng-runtime.
miguel: Logs look clean now. Queue down to 60, 5xx ~1.1%.
anna: Great. Next steps:
- Anna will open a post-incident thread with timeline + metrics + PR link for rollback. (I will file that now.)
- Devon will monitor for 2 hours and own pager handoff. (thanks)
- DevEx: publish temporary SDK advisory and code snippet to docs and ping community channels.
- CS: outreach to 3 customers immediate, status page update.
anna: Handing off to devon in 10m. tagging for handoff: @devon take over after 18:20 UTC.
devon: Taking over. Thanks @anna — I'll watch closely and escalate to runtime if we get >5% sustained 5xx for 10m.
anna: :white_check_mark: closing my loop, will update the post-incident thread shortly with root-cause and mitigation details.
oncall-bot: Incident closed for now (no active pages). Summary: emergency per-key rate limiting + stream concurrency reduction reduced error rate. Remind: follow-up RCA and permanent mitigation to be filed.
